title: Turn View
description: The front camera in the instrument cluster's widget with the next turn drawn on the road as chevrons and a turn card, from BMW Maps, Apple CarPlay or Android Auto. Pick "Turn View AR" in the cluster's widget menu (from the car's next start after installing); calibrate the camera once on a straight road. Needs the Turn View tool from the same source and Cluster renderer from robertnisipeanu/idrive-apps (0.5.10 or newer). iDrive 8 only.
